text_description: Full runway look in an all-black, subtly sparkling textured fabric, worn as a sleeveless deep-V top layered over a matching fluid midi skirt. The top has a long, straight, close-to-body silhouette ending around the hips, broad sleeveless shoulders, and a plunging neckline edged with soft irregular texture; a small gathered rosette or tied detail sits at the lower center of the V, drawing the neckline inward. The matching skirt sits below the top with an easy, draped fit and an uneven asymmetric hem that falls around mid-calf, dipping lower on one side and creating a soft wavy line as the model walks. The overall proportion is elongated and lean, with the dark glittering surface giving the set a dress-like evening effect while still reading as separated top and skirt. Styling is minimal, with small dark earrings and a large handheld structured tote in the left hand: the bag is mostly light-colored with bold vertical striping in black, orange, green, and white on the front, darker handles, and a contrasting patterned side panel that appears floral or tapestry-like. Footwear is only partly visible beneath the hem and appears dark, keeping the focus on the textured black ensemble and graphic bag.
